report: Osmani TV historical over-credit production normalization — FINAL REPORT
authorization: Explicit project-owner authorization in production normalization task.

safety.rollback_backup: 245 old rows + replay evidence stored atomically in subscription_normalization_backups
safety.failed_first_apply: Rolled back completely on status-constraint error; preflight counts remained identical.
safety.new_purchase_guard: Finalizer checked transaction_id and payment created_at; 149 finalized, 0 skipped. Any payment created after batch applied_at would have been preserved.

verification.sse: Removed sample snapshot: active=false/status=revoked/remaining_days=0/admin_revoked=true. Retained sample snapshot: active=true with canonical expiry and days.

root_causes: Historical activation/recovery logic repeatedly preserved or extended already-inflated expiries.
The prior repair function deliberately refused every expiry reduction or deactivation.
The prior audit loaded transactions only by current device_id, missing entitlement-linked orders on migration sources.
Runtime no-stack activation math was incorrectly reused for historical audit replay, falsely labeling legitimate paid overlaps.
Pending inactive rows could be reactivated by stale completed-payment verification until authoritative revoke markers were added.

policy.new_or_lapsed: Purchase EAT calendar date + duration_days at 00:00 Africa/Dar_es_Salaam.
policy.valid_paid_overlap: Each distinct completed payment or undeleted grant is counted exactly once and stacked.
policy.ownership: Device ID ownership follows explicit transaction/transfer/recovery lineage only; phone is never ownership evidence.
policy.unsupported: No completed payment or undeleted grant owned by Device ID => revoked/inactive until a new payment.

database_queries_executed: SELECT active device_subscriptions excluding admin-revoked rows.
SELECT all completed transactions joined to plans; purchase time = COALESCE(completed_at, created_at).
SELECT all undeleted manual_subscription_grants joined to plans.
SELECT completed device_transfers and replay ownership chronologically.
CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS subscription_normalization_backups.
INSERT old_row + computed_evidence into subscription_normalization_backups before each update.
UPDATE device_subscriptions using FOR UPDATE + compare-and-swap on status/expires_at/admin_revoked_at.
INSERT admin_subscription_revocation_actions for every removed entitlement.
Finalizer: SELECT backup rows FOR UPDATE; guard any transaction created after batch applied_at; set authoritative revoked markers.
